analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains at 54.4 in neutral territory, but the MACD histogram has worsened from 0.5584 to -0.6349, signaling a potential bearish shift. The volume ratio of 0.52 compared to the 5-day average also indicates subdued activity, lowering conviction. The current price of $720.37, down 14.6% from its 52-week high, is still 29.7% above its 52-week low, suggesting a position within an uptrend channel but potentially entering a consolidation phase.
